claims.claim: The existing protected reader and attention path cover EXECUTION, VERIFICATION and COMPLETION_GATE while preserving pre-RUN operational boundaries.

Diagnostic projections bind TASK/revision, RUN, base/candidate, terminal artifact, source digests and reader authority; currentness checks reject substitution and replay, with typed SOURCE_UNPROVEN provenance when authentication is unavailable.
Insufficient pytest summaries trigger bounded original-capture reads or typed blockers without rerunning verification or inventing failed nodes.
UNKNOWN-exception diagnostics recover available source-validated nodes, exception types, relative file/line and assertion values, with separate availability states for missing or withheld fields.
Field-level filtering preserves safe structural neighbors and emits typed redaction decisions; released assertion comparisons require committed-source AST proof.
The portable extension excludes raw prose, parameters, absolute paths, arbitrary string values and encoded or instructional spans, with adversarial privacy and substitution regression cases.

The implementation extends existing protected readers, GitSources and safe-detail/page contracts while retaining GitHub Actions attribution and protected raw captures, without adding a service, verifier or mutation authority.
Protected reads enforce byte, time, call and field bounds with typed limitations; legacy V1–V4 readers, paging and direct APIs remain supported, and historical failures are not backfilled.
Default Brain Sync and work-context consumers automatically traverse authenticated diagnostic reads, exercised through isolated real Git fixtures without source injection or private-log pasting.

Labeled source-bound fixtures reproduce the RUN-401-002 patch symptom and RUN-403-001/002 summary boundaries, with distinct blockers or signals for missing history, unproved retention and pytest execution-profile failures.

Regression cases cover execution, verification and completion causes, provenance/privacy negatives, pre-RUN and REVIEW/PUBLISH boundaries, and future unknown symptoms retaining their phase and source witness.
Brain projections remain observational, retain one bounded protected-source next-read selector, and add no automatic repair, retry, lifecycle creation, roadmap advancement or raw-log publication.
